identity.name: variengien-et-al-cartpole-nca-clean-room-reference
authority_order: pinned executable source and shipped checkpoint manifests

channels.1: hidden; forced to 1 at active inputs
channels.2: input identifier; globally cleared and rewritten each step
channels.3: output identifier; globally cleared and rewritten each step
channels.4: hidden; forced to 1 at inputs and incremented by 1 at outputs each step
channels.5: hidden; forced to 1 at inputs and incremented by 1 at outputs each step

graph.perception: learned full-channel 3x3 cross-correlation; not a fixed Sobel bank and not depthwise
graph.residual: state_next = state + delta * update_mask before I/O rewrite

write_order: clear every channel at active input cells
scatter scaled observations into input channel 0
io.input_deletion: remove the selected input from both clamp and marker sets; it becomes an intermediate cell

readout.values: channel 0 at the two output coordinates

schedule.hidden_state: pool state committed after every prediction; one-grid evaluation pool therefore persists across environment moves
schedule.episode_reset: paper says one random grid per simulation; current test harness does not explicitly reset its one-element grid pool between episodes

training.curriculum: first train both outputs to four times the mean of eight synthetic inputs, then load those weights for DQN
training.damage: random circle: center uniform[-0.5,0.5), radius uniform[0.3,0.4), all channels replaced uniform[-1,1)
training.learning_rate_schedule_not_applied_gap: a PiecewiseConstantDecay is constructed but the model is instantiated with scalar 0.005
training.loss: 0.5 * mean squared selected-output error + 100 * mean squared overflow outside [-5,5]
training.gradient_rule: each weight gradient divided by its own L2 norm plus 1e-8

environment.termination: abs(x)>2.4 or abs(theta)>12 degrees or step_count>10000
environment.paper_reward_discrepancy: paper describes -100 terminal reward; executable environment returns cosine reward and DQN wrapper substitutes -100 only in replay memory

exact_comparison.inputs: identical weights, float32 state, observations, masks, and optional noise/damage draws
exact_comparison.backend_note: exact hashes require the declared arithmetic runtime; Windows/Linux NumPy wheels may choose different floating reduction orders, so cross-platform CI compares complete stored arrays elementwise at the declared tolerance
exact_comparison.cross_episode_reset_gap: the released evaluation harness persists its one-element grid pool across episodes; paper prose says a random grid starts each simulation, so no unobserved historical episode-reset policy is claimed
